findings.rationale: Real internal contradiction (§8 freeze→smoke vs §11 smoke→freeze) plus pre-freeze data admission via smoke-row reuse. Repair: canonical order = harness+tests → Phase-0 smoke (non-gating, ≤6) → rules freeze → gating block; smoke rows are never reused as gating cells.

Correct on all three: Phase-0 probe already refuted the task-store channel so freezing 6 families/4-of-6 would freeze known-dead rules; ordering contradiction as in F1; d3/d4/d7 need explicit per-task branch topology the orchestration temp-repo init does not create. Repair: 5 families, V2 ≥4-of-5 (proportionally stricter, not laxer), per-task repo branch-layout spec.

Both sub-claims verified: CARD without its relocated references tree is content-ablation (straw-man, second variable); unset CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR can leak the operator's installed plugin into OFF (the working probe exported it, the runner spec did not). Repair: per-arm skills/dev-flow/references/ tree in the synthetic plugin (FULL=current, CARD=card tree), digest-pinned; runner exports scratch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; arm-isolation test asserts both.

Missing-cell semantics now pre-registered: a cell recorded missing after 3 attempts excludes that (task,rep) pair from ALL arms (paired exclusion keeps arms comparable); if any family loses ≥2 pairs the block is invalid; V1 denominator becomes effective per-arm run count.
